summary: Tested admin onboarding for all 21 Provider-App types (API + UI), the master-admin name/phone edit, no-login profile bulk suspend/unsuspend, the new role tabs, the Ravi Kumar admin-name fix, and the Doctor/Patient regressions. Signup wrote the right row to the right table for all 21 types. Validations work: 400 for a missing required field, a bad pincode or missing lat/lng; 409 for a duplicate profile or a duplicate licence; 403 for non-master users. Edit API and UI work, including 409 phone clash, 400 for the master number, 403 for non-master, and the no-login MedPlus admin-name change (restored to 'Ms. Anita Singh'). Bulk suspend then unsuspend on MedPlus worked via both API and UI, and KYC went back to verified. Found 3 real issues: (1) a phone edit writes users.phone as '+91XXXXXXXXXX', but every Provider-App users row and this signup use a bare 10-digit number, and the Provider App's verify-otp looks up `User.phone == data.phone` with an exact match, so the provider probably can't sign in with the new number; (2) new-role profiles (dental, vet, blood bank, nutritionist, mental wellness, ambulance driver, health camps) have no edit pencil and the PUT returns 400 'Unknown provider profile'; (3) after onboarding a new-role provider, /admin/onboarding/<uid> shows 'no profile table for this role', 0/0 docs, 'Already approved' and a green 'now live' banner, and calls /api/admin/labs/<uid>/staff, which returns 404. All test data (phones 90000990xx) has been deleted.

critical.issue: Sets users.phone='+91'+ten (and phone_key). Provider-App users rows store a bare 10-digit phone (80 bare vs 17 '+91' rows, and the '+91' ones are CRM admin rows). /admin/onboarding/signup also inserts a bare 10-digit phone. The cloned Provider App (backend/routes/auth.py verify-otp, and the auth_v2 _get_user_by_phone helper) looks up `User.phone == data.phone` with an exact match, and the mobile app sends a 10-digit phone. So after an admin changes the number, the Provider App most likely can't find the user (it may create a new account), which breaks the user's 'sign-in number changes' requirement. Reproduced: test pharmacy edited to 9000099040 -> users.phone='+919000099040'. The directory then also shows '+919000099041', inconsistent with the other rows. Fix: keep the existing format (write a bare 10-digit number when the old phone was a bare 10-digit number), or always write a bare 10-digit number.

minor.issue: Returns 400 'Unknown provider profile' because the allowed set is only cp.TABLES plus doctors and paramedic_profiles. The frontend EDITABLE list hides the pencil for these tables too. The user asked for name/phone edits 'wherever applicable', and these roles are now onboardable.

minor.endpoint: Provider details / KYC checklist for new roles (supabase_db profile lookup ~L1430 + server.kyc_checklist_for)
minor.issue: Neither _VERTICAL_PROFILE_SPEC nor the fallback table list includes the new tables, so the KYC page for an onboarded dental/vet/etc. user says 'no profile table for this role'. The checklist is also empty, so the page shows 'Already approved' with 0/0 docs and 'this provider is now live'. That is misleading, since the profile is pending and the success toast says 'now upload the KYC docs'.
The KYC page calls it for a dental user and gets 404 (twice), which is console noise.

Nurse goes to doctors with role doctor and nothing marks it as a nurse, so the onboarded nurse shows under the Doctor tab and not the Nurse tab. This matches the Provider App, which also drops the nurse subtype, but admins may find it confusing.
It only matched users.phone LIKE '90000990%', so a test provider whose phone was edited to '+9190000990xx' was left behind. Fixed by the tester: it now also matches '+9190000990%' and phone_key.

integration_issues.issue: The KYC page shows 'no profile table for this role', an 'Already approved' button, 0/0 docs and the 'Every required document is approved — now live' banner for a brand-new pending provider. It also describes the provider as a 'staff account (dental)'.
No provider-edit-<row_key> pencil on the Dental clinic, Blood bank, Veterinarian, Nutritionist, Mental wellness, Ambulance driver or Health camps tabs.

issues: Phone column formats differ after an edit: '+919000099041' next to bare 10-digit numbers

action_items: provider_edit.py: when changing users.phone, write a bare 10-digit number (the Provider App format), not '+91'+ten, so Provider-App login keeps working; keep phone_key in sync

Allow name/phone edit for the new role tables (dental_clinics.owner_name/clinic_name, vet_clinics, blood_banks incharge_name/bank_name, wellness_event_providers organiser_name/display_name, nutritionists/wellness_professionals/ambulance_driver_profiles full_name as person tables) in both the backend allowed set and the frontend EDITABLE

KYC/details page: add the new role tables to the profile lookup and a KYC checklist for the new verticals; don't show 'Already approved' or the 'now live' banner when the checklist is empty and verification is pending
critical_code_review_comments: provider_onboarding._insert: when the phone already belongs to a users row (e.g. a Patient App user), users.role/user_type is left unchanged, so the Provider App may route that login as a patient. Confirm this is intended.

provider_onboarding: the new users row doesn't set phone_key, while provider_edit relies on phone_key for clash checks. This is OK because the clash check also uses regexp on phone, but the data is inconsistent.
Duplicate-licence UniqueViolation returns a 409 with 'pharmacy providers drug license number must be unique'. Good, but the message could name the field in plainer words.

Backend log contains past tracebacks (UniqueViolation ix_doctors_license_number and a hospital_data read-only error) from another code path, apparently unhandled 500s; worth checking which endpoint raised them.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login on the UI needs the 'Trata Staff' role tile first (login-role-selector), then phone/OTP/password. The pytest file onboards all 21 types on 90000990xx; pharmacy needs a unique drug licence. Always run `python scripts/cleanup_test_onboarding.py` afterwards. Doctor tab, excluding test phones, has 5 doctors; patients = 10. Provider App clone is at /tmp/tp; its auth uses an exact users.phone match.
rca of the issue: Phone edit: provider_edit.py line ~86 hardcodes user_sets phone=f'+91{ten}', but the Provider App stores and looks up users.phone as the raw 10-digit number. New-role gaps: provider_edit's allowed set and the frontend EDITABLE only list the original 6 tables plus doctors/paramedic, and supabase_db's profile lookup and kyc_checklist_for were not extended to the 7 new role tables.
